content.title: AtomOne Logo Selection Option #1
content.description:
### **Proposal: Community Voting for AtomOne Logo Selection Option \#1**

You can find the proposed logo [here](https://images-platform.99static.com/Tst5YeHuNKcNRdJl47_VFSH3NiU=/filters:quality\(100\)/99designs-contests-attachments/153/153370/attachment_153370218)**.**

**Summary:**

This governance proposal seeks to gauge GovGen’s community sentiment on a placeholder logo for AtomOne, selected from two design competitions held by All in Bits Inc. This logo will serve as a temporary symbol until the AtomOne community selects an official logo in the future.

This proposal does not establish the official AtomOne logo but should be viewed as a placeholder. Other community members are encouraged to submit alternative logo designs for consideration. It will be up to the GovGen community to select the preferred placeholder logo, and ultimately, the future AtomOne community to decide on the official branding.

Our proposal is that the logo receiving the highest percentage of “YES”  within the GovGen governance community process by October 10, 2024, 23:59 UTC time will serve as the temporary logo for the AtomOne project. The placeholder will be used across all platforms until the future AtomOne community makes a final decision on an official logo.

Community input is essential in ensuring that the selected placeholder logo resonates with AtomOne values of decentralization, collaboration, and innovation.

**Here are the details of the proposal:**

1. **Design Competitions Recap:** Several talented members of our community have submitted logo designs during the [AtomOne Logo Design Competition.](https://github.com/atomone-hub/assets/issues/3) Additionally, submissions were received from another competition held on [https://99designs.co.uk/](https://99designs.co.uk/). From these competitions, four logos were shortlisted. The GovGen community is now invited to review these options and vote on their preferred placeholder logo design for the AtomOne project.   
2. **Voting Process:** The designs will be presented on-chain for voting, allowing each community member to express their opinion on which logo would best represent AtomOne. The logo with the highest percentage of YES votes will be selected as the official placeholder logo for the AtomOne project.  
3. **Voting period:** In regards to measuring GovGen’s preference over the AtomOne temporary logo, this governance proposal proposes that the community sentiment be measured over a 10 days voting period, ending on October 10th, 2024, 23:59 UTC time.  
4. **Community Priority:** This vote is crucial because the community’s voice is GovGen’s highest priority. AtomOne is designed as a decentralized project from the start, and therefore any decision, including branding should reflect the consensus of the community. Everyone is encouraged to participate and help contribute to the proposed visual identity of AtomOne.  
5. **Next Steps:** Once the voting concludes, All in Bits, Inc. will assist with integrating the selected placeholder logo across all AtomOne platforms, including but not limited to websites, social media, documentation, explorers, and branding materials.

---

**Voting Options:**

* Yes (You agree with/ like the proposed choice for the AtomOne logo)  
* No (You do not agree with/ like the proposed choice for the AtomOne logo)  
* Abstain (You neither agree or disagree with the proposed choice for the AtomOne logo)  
* No With Veto (You believe that this proposal is spam) 

---

**Conclusion:** This is a valuable opportunity for the GovGen community to contribute to the AtomOne’s branding and identity ongoing process. Your participation in this vote is essential to shaping the future of the AtomOne project.

**Voting Timeline:**  
This current governance proposal is suggesting for the sentiment to be measured until October 10th 23:59 UTC time and the implementation of the temporary AtomOne proposed logo to take into account the vote results registered until this date, but the vote can continue on chain after this period so that it could capture a broader community sentiment.

**Note:** This current proposal represents one option for the potential AtomOne future logo, from a series of initial four proposals put forward by All in Bits, Inc., as a contribution to the AtomOne future brand identity, but many other proposals can be be listed by any other community members anytime during the project’s lifespan. It is up to the AtomOne future governance community to take the lead and decide what their official logo will be once and if the AtomOne chain will go live.
